title: The Midnight Cabal
kicker: A whispered name for impossible jobs and doors that opened without permission.
hook: The Midnight Cabal: a whispered future-thread name for impossible jobs and locked doors that opened anyway.

blocks.label: Public Face
blocks.body: A whispered name for impossible jobs and doors that opened without permission.

blocks.label: How To Deal
blocks.body: Nobody reliable claims to have hired the Midnight Cabal. That is part of the brand, if it is a brand. The stories always include one locked door, one unpaid debt, and one witness who insists the candle blew out by itself.

affordances: Compare their slogan to what they actually do in the scene.
